typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Notification Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Report Name} as string,
		{Member Name} as string,
		DCN as string,
		BLL as double,
		{Capillary or Venous} as string,
		{Date Specimen Collected} as string,
		Status as string,
		{CM Assigned} as string,
		{Comments: } as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(SrcFile = left($SrcFile + '          ', 10)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of SrcFile} = toString(SrcFile),
		{Copy of DCN} = toString(DCN),
		{Copy of BLL} = toString(BLL)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		SrcFile as string,
		AltKey as string,
		Member_Name as string,
		LeadResult as string,
		EffDateString as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SrcFile = {Copy of SrcFile},
		AltKey = {Copy of DCN},
		Member_Name = {Copy of Member Name},
		LeadResult = {Copy of BLL},
		EffDateString = {Copy of Date Specimen Collected})) ~> OLEDBDestination
